record.excerpt: Divergence is one of the best technical analysis theories. … Although not 100%, a very high probability of profitability is well known. … Signals: Blue ascending arrows in RSI & MACD … Instances of Bullish Divergences (Green Arrows) 29 instances, probability of profitability > 85% … Instances of Bearish Divergences (Red Arrows) 17 instances, probability of profitability > 90%
record.notes: Hand-marked RSI/MACD divergences with precise-looking success rates but no definition of divergence, exit or horizon; compiler should flag as discretionary.

spec.claim_summary: The claim states that RSI and MACD bullish and bearish divergences predict profitable moves with success rates above 85% and 90%.
spec.untestable_reason: RSI and MACD bullish/bearish divergence requires comparing successive price pivots to indicator pivots, which cannot be expressed as single-bar close conditions in the available schema.
